messages:
ciara: Heads-up: QA smoke picked up a small but consistent NDCG drop (~0.6%) on reranker workloads when switched to INT8 pack on model-c. Seen across a few customers but concentrated on short candidate lists (<=5).
raj: 0.6% is small but not negligible for rerank. Any sign it's data drift vs quant bias?
ciara: We replayed identical evaluation inputs on FP32 vs INT8. The top-1 shifts are systematicnot random.
leila: Could be softmax scaling mismatch after the final linear + bias quantization. INT8 requant uses a single scale for the output blob and we may be losing relative logits magnitude.
max: Do we have per-layer quant stats for the output layer (mean/std, min/max)?
ciara: I exported a few histograms. Sample: ```
output_layer_logits_fp32: min=-6.2 max=8.9 mean=0.23 std=1.37
output_layer_int8_q:  min=-28 max=33  scale=0.283
reconstruction_error: kl=0.012 mae=0.09
```
raj: KL 0.012 seems small but for ranking the tail differences matter. If relative gaps compress, top candidate can swap.
leila: Two quick mitigations: 1) per-endpoint softmax temperature rescaling during postproc (heuristic: scale logits by a calibrated factor s) 2) per-model bias correction added to int8 requant table (a cheap zero-point offset).
max: Adding a small per-endpoint temperature is tempting but we must avoid masking real model regressions. It should be gated behind canary and telemetry.
ciara: Agreed. I ran a quick local: multiplying logits by 1.08 (i.e., s=1.08) recovered ~0.55% of the drop on our eval set.
leila: That suggests compression. We should also check headwise gradients near output layer. But a config-driven softmax_scale might be the fastest rollout.
raj: Proposed rollout plan: a) add telemetry fields rerank_delta (ndcg_int8 - ndcg_fp32), softmax_scale_applied, quant_bias_correction_enabled. b) Add a router flag: prefer_int8_for_rerank = false for critical routes until calibration is done.
max: Also add an automated calibration job that computes optimal softmax_scale per model variant using a held-out sample (N=10k queries). Keep it as a small table: {model_variant -> scale}. Job runs daily.
ciara: For sensitive customers we can expose an override on endpoint config: quant_fallback_threshold and softmax_scale_override.
leila: Runtime: small perf cost to apply scale (single multiply per-candidate) is negligible. Bias correction requires extending requant metadata with a tiny bias vector (same shape as logits). Storage cost minimal.
raj: Security/compliance note: we must persist calibration artifacts in object store with encryption and TTL.
deploybot: deploybot: Canary created: RERANK-INT8-CALIB-2026-09-21 - shadow mode first.
max: Tests: add unit-test that compares topK stability between FP32 and INT8+scale within tolerance, and a synthetic adversarial case where logits are near-tied.
ciara: Action items: 1) Leila: prototype softmax_scale table + small API for overrides. 2) Max: calibration job and unit tests. 3) Raj: endpoint config UX and storage policy. 4) Olivia? (not here) to inform CS for impacted customers.
leila: I'll sketch schema: ```
quant_rerank_calib.yaml:
  model: model-c-v2
  computed_scale: 1.08
  kl_reduction: 0.006
  sample_count: 10000
  created_at: 2026-09-21T10:12:00Z
  encrypted_path: s3://redwood-calib/....enc
```
max: We'll include a canary dashboard: NDCG_f32, NDCG_int8_raw, NDCG_int8_scaled, rerank_delta. Canary will fail if scaled doesn't reduce delta by >=50%.
raj: Ops question: Do we want to bake this into Dedicated clusters automatically? Maybe not until we confirm stability across workloads.
ciara: For now mark dedicated default unchanged. For hosted, we'll route a small shadow slice with scale applied and compare.
leila: Long-term: evaluate sign-preserving requant or asymmetric per-channel scales for the final linear. That would reduce need for ad-hoc scale. But it's bigger runtime change.
max: Yup, file that under "quantization-engine" refactor backlog. Short-term goal: instrumentation + calibration job + safe rollout polygon.
ciara: Thanks team. I'll open an RFC-lite summarizing tests and initial calibration numbers.
raj: Thanks 44d
deploybot: deploybot: Link to canary results dashboard will be posted to #eng-ml when available.
